BiblicalUsage: Zaavan is named twice in the Bible, and the passages here are Genesis 36:27; 1 Chronicles 1:42. In Genesis 36:27 we read, "The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan." It appears again in 1 Chronicles 1:42: "The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan."
TheologicalSignificance: Zaavan is one of the names that makes the Bible feel like a real history to me. The record keeps him, and I am glad it does.
